# npz

## basic interation

The primal format to save array in numpy.

```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

vec1 = stats.uniform.rvs(loc=0, scale=1-0, size=(10, 10))
vec2 = stats.uniform.rvs(loc=0, scale=1-0, size=(10, 10))

# savez
out_path = "./04_package/files_interation/files_interation.npz" 
np.savez(
    out_path,
    vec1=vec1,
    vec2=vec2,
)

# read
data = np.load(out_path)
vec1 = data["vec1"]
vec2 = data["vec2"]
```
